name: Plume
author: E. T. Carter
description: A single slender column of dye rises from bottom-center, FBM-textured and glowing warmest at its dense base, cooling as it climbs, widens, and dissipates into the near-black upper frame; a height-increasing cross-current shears it into a smooth bow that sheds faint wisps off its downstream edge.

params.label: Rise speed
params.effect: Upward scroll rate of the dye — incense-slow at min, a brisk thermal at max.

params.label: Shear
params.effect: Strength of the height-increasing side current — zero rises dead straight, max bends the column hard toward the frame edge.

params.label: Base width
params.effect: CSS-pixel width of the column at its base — a pencil line of smoke up to a broad soft pillar.
